pages.text: The $(item)gilder's post$(): made with a golden carrot. Fence in tilled soil.

pages.title: Gold That Grows
pages.text: I did not expect this one to work. A golden carrot, a golden apple, a glistering slice of melon, set in tilled soil by the hand and by no one else, grow.$(br2)Each comes back as two, or as a melon of slices. An enchanted apple grows as well. Slowly. I have stopped asking what it grows on.
